units.text: Article 66
units.label: Art. 66

units.text: 1. The status of a republic is determined by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and the constitution of the republic.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 66

units.text: 2. The status of a territory, region, city of federal significance, autonomous region or autonomous area is determined by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and the charter of the territory, region, city of federal significance, autonomous region or autonomous area, adopted by the legislative (representative) body of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 66

units.text: 3. Upon a submission by the legislative and executive bodies of an autonomous region or autonomous area, a federal law on that autonomous region or autonomous area may be adopted.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 66

units.text: 4. The relations of autonomous areas forming part of a territory or region may be regulated by federal law and a treaty between the bodies of state authority of the autonomous area and, respectively, the bodies of state authority of the territory or region.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 66

units.text: 5. The status of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may be changed by mutual agreement of the Russian Federation and that constituent entity in accordance with federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 66

units.text: Article 67
units.label: Art. 67

units.text: 1. The territory of the Russian Federation includes the territories of its constituent entities, inland waters and the territorial sea, and the airspace above them. Federal territories may be established within the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with federal law. The organization of public authority in federal territories is established by that federal law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 67

units.text: 2. The Russian Federation possesses sovereign rights and exercises jurisdiction over the continental shelf and the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation in the manner determined by federal law and rules of international law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 67

units.text: 2.1. The Russian Federation ensures the protection of its sovereignty and territorial integrity. Actions aimed at alienating part of the territory of the Russian Federation (except delimitation, demarcation and redemarcation of the state border of the Russian Federation with neighbouring States), and calls for such actions, are not permitted.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 67

units.text: 3. Boundaries between constituent entities of the Russian Federation may be changed by their mutual agreement.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 67

units.text: Article 67.1
units.label: Art. 67.1

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation is the legal successor of the USSR in its territory and also the legal successor (continuing State) of the USSR in respect of membership of international organizations and their bodies, participation in international treaties, and obligations and assets of the USSR outside the territory of the Russian Federation provided for by international treaties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 67.1

units.text: 2. The Russian Federation, united by a thousand-year history, preserving the memory of ancestors who passed on to us ideals and faith in God, and continuity in the development of the Russian State, recognizes the historically established unity of the State.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 67.1

units.text: 3. The Russian Federation honours the memory of defenders of the Fatherland and ensures the protection of historical truth. Diminishing the significance of the people's heroic achievement in defending the Fatherland is not permitted.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 67.1

units.text: 4. Children are the foremost priority of Russia's state policy. The State creates conditions conducive to children's comprehensive spiritual, moral, intellectual and physical development and to fostering patriotism, civic responsibility and respect for elders in them. While ensuring the priority of family upbringing, the State assumes parental duties towards children left without care.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 67.1

units.text: Article 68
units.label: Art. 68

units.text: 1. The state language of the Russian Federation throughout its territory is Russian, as the language of the state-forming people, which forms part of the multinational union of equal peoples of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 68

units.text: 2. Republics are entitled to establish their own state languages. In bodies of state authority, local self-government bodies and state institutions of the republics, these languages are used alongside the state language of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 68

units.text: 3. The Russian Federation guarantees all its peoples the right to preserve their native language and the creation of conditions for its study and development.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 68

units.text: 4. Culture in the Russian Federation is the unique heritage of its multinational people. Culture is supported and protected by the State.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 68

units.text: Article 69
units.label: Art. 69

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation guarantees the rights of indigenous small-numbered peoples in accordance with universally recognized principles and rules of international law and international treaties of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 69

units.text: 2. The State protects the cultural identity of all peoples and ethnic communities of the Russian Federation and guarantees the preservation of ethnocultural and linguistic diversity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 69

units.text: 3. The Russian Federation supports compatriots living abroad in exercising their rights, securing protection of their interests and preserving their shared Russian cultural identity.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 69

units.text: Article 70
units.label: Art. 70

units.text: 1. The state flag, coat of arms and anthem of the Russian Federation, their description and the procedure for their official use are established by federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 70

units.text: 2. The capital of the Russian Federation is the city of Moscow. The status of the capital is established by federal law. Individual federal bodies of state authority may have their permanent seat in another city designated by federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 70

units.text: Article 71
units.label: Art. 71

units.text: The Russian Federation has jurisdiction over:
units.label: Art. 71 · “The Russian Federation has jurisdiction over:”

units.text: а) adoption and amendment of the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws, and supervision of their observance;
units.label: Point «а» Art. 71

units.text: б) the federal structure and territory of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 71

units.text: в) regulation and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms; citizenship in the Russian Federation; regulation and protection of the rights of ethnic minorities;
units.label: Point «в» Art. 71

units.text: г) organization of public authority; establishment of the system of federal legislative, executive and judicial bodies and the procedure for their organization and activity; formation of federal bodies of state authority;
units.label: Point «г» Art. 71

units.text: д) federal state property and its management;
units.label: Point «д» Art. 71

units.text: е) establishment of the foundations of federal policy and federal programmes in the fields of state, economic, environmental, scientific and technological, social, cultural and national development of the Russian Federation; establishment of unified legal foundations for healthcare and upbringing and education systems, including continuing education;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 71

units.text: ж) establishment of the legal foundations of a single market; financial, currency, credit and customs regulation, currency issuance and the foundations of pricing policy; federal economic services, including federal banks;
units.label: Point «ж» Art. 71

units.text: з) the federal budget; federal taxes and levies; federal regional development funds;
units.label: Point «з» Art. 71

units.text: и) federal energy systems, nuclear energy and fissile materials; federal transport, transport routes, information, information technologies and communications; space activities;
units.label: Point «и» Art. 71

units.text: к) foreign policy and international relations of the Russian Federation and international treaties of the Russian Federation; issues of war and peace;
units.label: Point «к» Art. 71

units.text: л) foreign economic relations of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «л» Art. 71

units.text: м) defence and security; defence production; determination of the procedure for selling and purchasing weapons, ammunition, military equipment and other military property; production of toxic substances and narcotic drugs and the procedure for their use; ensuring the security of the individual, society and the State in the use of information technologies and the circulation of digital data;
units.label: Point «м» Art. 71

units.text: н) determination of the status and protection of the state border, territorial sea, airspace, exclusive economic zone and continental shelf of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «н» Art. 71

units.text: о) the court system; the procuracy; criminal and penal enforcement legislation; amnesty and pardon; civil legislation; procedural legislation; legal regulation of intellectual property <18>;
units.label: Point «о» Art. 71

units.text: п) federal conflict-of-laws rules;
units.label: Point «п» Art. 71

units.text: р) metrological services, standards, measurement standards, the metric system and time reckoning; geodesy and cartography; names of geographical features; meteorological services; official statistical and accounting records;
units.label: Point «р» Art. 71

units.text: с) state awards and honorary titles of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «с» Art. 71

units.text: т) federal state service; establishment of restrictions on holding state and municipal offices and positions in state and municipal service, including restrictions connected with foreign citizenship or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, and restrictions connected with opening or holding accounts (deposits) and keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point «т» Art. 71

units.text: <18> Point ‘о’ is reproduced as amended by the Law of the Russian Federation on an Amendment to the Constitution of the Russian Federation No. 2-ФКЗ of 5 February 2014, ‘On the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation and the Procuracy of the Russian Federation’, which entered into force on the date of its official publication, 6 February 2014 (Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (www.pravo.gov.ru), 2014, 6 February, No. 0001201402060001).

units.text: Article 72
units.label: Art. 72

units.text: 1. The Russian Federation and the constituent entities of the Russian Federation have joint jurisdiction over:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: а) ensuring that the constitutions and laws of republics and the charters, laws and other normative legal acts of territories, regions, cities of federal significance, the autonomous region and autonomous areas conform to the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws;
units.label: Point «а» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: б) protection of human and civil rights and freedoms; protection of the rights of ethnic minorities; ensuring legality, law and order, and public safety; the regime of border zones;
units.label: Point «б» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: в) matters of possession, use and disposal of land, subsoil, water and other natural resources;
units.label: Point «в» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: г) delimitation of state property;
units.label: Point «г» Part 1 Art. 72

units.text: д) use of natural resources; agriculture; environmental protection and ensuring environmental safety; specially protected natural areas; protection of historical and cultural monuments;
units.label: Point «д» Part 1 Art. 72
